title: Ledger
lede: Not announcements. Rooms that can be visited, commands that ran, files that exist. The garden keeps what it can prove.

entries.title: The Governor remembers Jay
entries.body: Slot 1 was a twenty-eight-character stub. The fifteen identity files were on disk and unused. They now sit as signed generation b06de077, picked and gated, and the Governor answers as partner rather than stranger.
evidence: gate: list_tools and canonical shards present in slot 1

entries.title: Suture is his hand
entries.body: Training requires a tool that actually runs. suture_execute is attached as tool one. The daemon is up on :47892 against /home/ubuntu/Council-OS. The gateway on :8800 executed a unique marker to disk; he quoted it back.

entries.title: The hive gathers from Qwen
entries.body: Forage is GPU 2 hive-research at :8002, n=256, 8k. Merge is the same engine packing as qwen_long. Gemma on :8800 does not forage; Qwen does not issue. Live ticks are labelled forage (8 qwen-wide).
evidence: governor chat only through :8800, never raw :8000
if Qwen is down, forage suspends; the Governor does not swarm

entries.title: A screen until they agree
entries.body: Gemstone Discourse is the room where Qwen and Gemma take turns until converged or stalemate. The public hostname was dead on another box. It lives here now, seats pointed at the live minds.

entries.title: Prometheus sits beside the Governor
entries.body: The independent judge is Prometheus 2 7B, Mistral lineage, no seat in the argument. Stock protocol serve would have landed on GPU 0. He was pinned to leftover GPU 1 VRAM, util 0.20, port :8010. Auto rooms now read Prometheus plus arithmetic. ERROR: X-2 forbids a second CUDA resident on GPU 1.
evidence: GPU 1: 59 → 79 GB used, 18 GB still free

open.title: Prometheus on GPU 1 violates exclusive Governor card
open.body: judge-prometheus was launched onto leftover GPU 1 VRAM. Doctrine X-2 and PIC require a single CUDA resident. Commission wi-1788562184530376486 is the implement.
open.next: claim wi-1788562184530376486 — docker stop judge-prometheus (GPU 3 cannot take 20GiB beside existing fashion/FLUX)

open.title: Qwen has no Qwen Code
open.body: The engine and qwen3_coder parser are live on :8002. The terminal coding agent is not installed: no qwen binary, no ~/.qwen/settings.json. gemstone qwen code as-is would still aim at the jury on :8001.

open.title: Big Brother is not in the room
open.body: suture_code is attached as the Governor’s pair-programmer and currently fails: chdir /home/Ubuntu/gemstone — wrong case, wrong path.
